scripts.dev:frontend: npm run clean:dev && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev: npm run clean:dev && concurrently -k -n api,web,worker -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run verify:routes && npm run build:backend && npm run build:worker && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/backend exec tsc -- --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm --workspace apps/frontend exec tsc -- --noEmit
scripts.docker:up: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { execSync('docker --version', {stdio:'inherit'}); execSync('docker compose up -d postgres redis', {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch (e) { console.error('Docker is not installed or not available on PATH. Install Docker Desktop or ensure Docker is running, then retry.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.docker:down: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { execSync('docker --version', {stdio:'inherit'}); execSync('docker compose down', {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch (e) { console.error('Docker is not installed or not available on PATH. Install Docker Desktop or ensure Docker is running, then retry.'); process.exit(1); }"
